records.title: 2027 Information Technology Summer Internship Programme
records.notes: Jefferies 2027 IT Summer Internship, London, Opportunity ID 1967. Clearance filter clean. Fit 7.0: programming (Python, JavaScript, SQL), automation, API integration, AI/ML concepts, strong communication and process improvement. Eligibility barrier: requires penultimate-year student graduating 2028; user completed MSc 2025. Disclosed in cover letter. Gaps: no KDB, Bloomberg API, Snowflake or commercial AWS experience. Note: Jefferies limits candidates to ONE application per recruiting cycle. Note: separate from the earlier Jefferies Software Engineer CV built for a recruiter approach (Alicia Lidbury) - that was not a formal application.
